notes: Critical advisories that are known and intentionally not blocking this release. Every entry has a remediation path and is tracked for a follow-up. Any critical advisory NOT listed here fails `pnpm audit:ci`. Example-only findings are separated from the published SDK report: examples are private, unpublished workspaces.

entries.reason: vitest 3.2.x pins tinypool ^1.1.1 and is tightly coupled to its worker-pool API, so tinypool cannot be upgraded independently without breaking vitest.
entries.remediation: Upgrade vitest to a release that depends on tinypool 2.x (vitest 5.x) and re-run `pnpm audit:ci`.
